source: Citi and PNC customer notices on AI agents, Nov 19 2026 (The Neuron digest, Sam on AI brief)

scenes.title: Banks: [[you pay]] for your AI's mistakes
scenes.tamil: AI agent தப்பு பண்ணா, பொறுப்பு நீங்க தான்!
scenes.say: Big banks say if your AI agent makes a mistake with your money, you are responsible.

scenes.code:
AI agent acts for you
= you own the result
scenes.say: Citi and PNC told customers they own whatever their AI agents do.

scenes.en: Never give AI your bank login

scenes.tamil: Bank statement-ஐ வாரா வாரம் check பண்ணுங்க
scenes.say_ta: Bank statement-ஐ வாரா வாரம் check பண்ணுங்க!

scenes.en: Would you let AI handle your bank? Comment!
